Perfect! ✓ Task complete.

**Summary:**
- Implemented `SlugifyWith(s, Options)` with full MaxLen support
- Handles word-boundary cutting: stops at the last complete word that fits within MaxLen
- Properly handles UTF-8 character boundaries when truncating the first word (no mid-character cuts)
- All test cases pass
- Added example to README
- Committed changes

The implementation correctly handles all edge cases including:
- Custom separators
- Length caps with word boundaries
- Multi-byte UTF-8 characters (e.g., "ü" is 2 bytes)
- Cases where even the first word exceeds MaxLen
